title: StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. translated_title: StepBack：面向高效测试时推理的步级错误定位重采样方法
translated_abstract: 自洽性（Self-Consistency, SC）是一种广泛用于改进思维链推理的解码策略，但它需要以预设预算采样大量完整的推理轨迹。其高效变体主要通过提前停止完整轨迹采样或在多个问题之间分配采样数量来降低成本。在本文中，我们提出了StepBack，一种用于高效测试时推理的步级错误定位重采样方法。给定一小组草稿轨迹，StepBack利用轻量级信号定位可能首次出现错误的位置，然后对检测到的错误步骤及其后缀进行重采样，最后进行多数答案投票。实验结果表明，StepBack在七个数学推理和多跳问答基准上平均达到了与SC相当的准确率，同时最多可将token使用量降低41.26%。此外，StepBack天然可以与自适应推理方法（如Adaptive Consistency）相结合，进一步提升性能。
tldr: StepBack通过轻量级信号定位推理草稿轨迹中首次出错的步骤，仅对该错误步骤及其后续内容进行重采样再投票，在七个数学推理与多跳问答基准上达到与自洽性相当的准确率，同时最多减少41.26%的token消耗。
en_tdlr: StepBack localizes the likely first error step in draft reasoning trajectories using lightweight signals and resamples only that step and its suffix before majority voting, matching self-consistency accuracy while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%.
